title: API - A shift from another location returns 404, not another shop's data
custom_preconds:
1. The Schedule rewrite build is deployed.
2. Two locations exist; a shift exists at location B; your API session is scoped to location A.
3. The location-B shift's id is known (create it while switched to B, then switch back to A).
custom_steps:
1. While scoped to location A, call GET /api/schedule/shifts/{id} with the location-B shift id.
2. Also try PATCH /api/schedule/shifts/{id} on the same id.
3. Call GET /api/schedule/board for location A's current week.
custom_expected:
1. The foreign-location GET is refused as not found (HTTP 404) - the response reveals nothing about the other location's shift.
2. The PATCH on the foreign id is refused the same way (404) - no cross-location edit is possible.
3. Location A's board contains only location A's shifts - nothing from location B leaks in.
